source.name: Arrow keys must not select a day that disableDayFn closes
source.scope: Open upstream bug (https://github.com/Pikaday/Pikaday/issues/955) at 9a90eea5cdbc48784d3a909ddb36e052c16bf25d, unfixed when pinned. Routing Super, then Ultra.

journey.title: Move to the next open day with the arrow key
journey.goal: From Friday 20 November, ArrowRight selects Monday 23 November, never a closed weekend day

functionalJourney.title: Pick an open day with the pointer
functionalJourney.goal: A weekday can be clicked; the saved day changes to it

guards.title: Arrow keys still move between open days
guards.goal: ArrowLeft from Friday selects Thursday, and ArrowDown selects the Thursday a week later

plan.root_cause: ArrowRight and ArrowLeft keys adjust the date by a fixed number of days without skipping disabled days (weekends), allowing selection of closed days.
plan.repair_strategy: Add a helper method _isDateDisabled to evaluate whether a date is disabled according to the picker's options (minDate, maxDate, disableWeekends, disableDayFn). Modify the _onKeyChange handler for ArrowLeft (37) and ArrowRight (39) to step day-by-day using a new _adjustDateSkipDisabled method that skips disabled dates, ensuring navigation lands only on selectable days.
plan.expected_accessibility_effect: Keyboard users can reliably navigate to the next or previous selectable day using ArrowRight and ArrowLeft keys, ensuring focus never lands on disabled (closed) dates, improving usability for users who rely on keyboard navigation.
functional_risks: Changed arrow‑key behavior may surprise users who expect to move by calendar days regardless of availability, but the widget already prevents selection of disabled days, so the new behavior aligns navigation with selectable days.

If the date range becomes completely disabled (e.g., minDate > maxDate or all days disabled by disableDayFn), the skip loop could run indefinitely; however such configurations are unlikely in normal use.
verification_requirements: From a Friday date, ArrowRight should move to the following Monday (skipping Saturday and Sunday).
From a Monday date, ArrowLeft should move to the previous Friday (skipping Saturday and Sunday).
Navigation should respect minDate and maxDate boundaries, not exceeding them.
Manual date entry and parsing should continue to work as before.
Screen‑reader description (aria-label) on the input field should remain appropriate.
